# ============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION FOR THE FIT REAL DATA: group differences (contrasts) in terms of WSLS parameters
# ============================================================================
# This script loads the saved results from the fit hier WSLS model & makes plots
# Namely: plots for WSLS parameters & contrasts
# Also: density plots for using posterior samples & some cvs including reportable data
# ============================================================================

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, ggpubr)

probit_to_prob <- function(x) pnorm(x) #convert from probit to probability scale (for density plots)
```

# ---------------------------
# 1. PATHS
# ---------------------------
```{r}
root_path <- "~/IGT_LLM_DecisionMaking"
results_dir <- file.path(root_path, "src/4_comparison/results")
plot_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "plots")
dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Read the data (param contrasts)
contrasts <- read_csv(file.path(results_dir, "group_parameters", "group_parameter_contrasts.csv"),show_col_types = FALSE)
estimates <- read_csv(file.path(results_dir, "group_parameters", "group_parameter_estimates.csv"),show_col_types = FALSE)

# Load posterior samples
posterior_samples_param <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "group_parameters", "posterior_samples.rds"))

```

# ============================================================================
# 2. PLOTS FOR *PARAM* CONTRAST! (estimates and contrasts)
# ============================================================================
```{r}
#RESHAPE both dfs for plotting
plot_estimates <- estimates %>%
  select(group, starts_with("mu_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -group,
    names_to = c("parameter", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "mu_(.*)_(median|q025|q975)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c("ahn_hc", "gpt_OLD_2023", "gpt_NEW_2025"),
      labels = c("Human Controls", "GPT-2023", "GPT-2025")
    ),
    parameter = factor(
      parameter,
      levels = c("prob_stay_win", "prob_switch_lose"),
      labels = c("P(stay|win)", "P(switch|lose)")
    )
  )

#contrasts df: reshape and select relevant columns for plotting
diffs_long <- contrasts %>%
  select(
    parameter,
    diff_gpt2023_hc_median, diff_gpt2023_hc_q025, diff_gpt2023_hc_q975,
    diff_gpt2025_hc_median, diff_gpt2025_hc_q025, diff_gpt2025_hc_q975,
    diff_gpt2025_gpt2023_median, diff_gpt2025_gpt2023_q025, diff_gpt2025_gpt2023_q975
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -parameter,
    names_to = c("comparison", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "diff_(.*)_(median|q025|q975)"
  )

# Pivot probabilities separately
probs_long <- contrasts %>%
  select(
    parameter,
    prob_gpt2023_greater_hc,
    prob_gpt2025_greater_hc,
    prob_gpt2025_greater_gpt2023
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -parameter,
    names_to = "comparison",
    values_to = "prob"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = case_when(
      comparison == "prob_gpt2023_greater_hc" ~ "gpt2023_hc",
      comparison == "prob_gpt2025_greater_hc" ~ "gpt2025_hc",
      comparison == "prob_gpt2025_greater_gpt2023" ~ "gpt2025_gpt2023"
    )
  )

# Join diffs and probs (struggling)
plot_contrasts <- diffs_long %>%
  left_join(probs_long, by = c("parameter", "comparison")) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = factor(
      comparison,
      levels = c("gpt2023_hc", "gpt2025_hc", "gpt2025_gpt2023"),
      labels = c("GPT-2023 vs Human", "GPT-2025 vs Human", "GPT-2025 vs GPT-2023")
    ),
    parameter = factor(
      parameter,
      levels = c("prob_stay_win", "prob_switch_lose"),
      labels = c("P(stay|win)", "P(switch|lose)")
    )
  )

```

```{r}
# Create the plot (estimates)
ggplot(plot_estimates, aes(x = group, y = median, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = q025, ymax = q975),
    width = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual( 
    name = "Groups",
    values = c(
      "Human Controls" = "#3498db",
      "GPT-2023" = "#e74c3c",
      "GPT-2025" = "#fcc200"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Parameter Value (median ± 95% CI)",
    x = NULL,
    title = "Group-Level Parameter Estimates (Probability Space)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95")
  )

ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, "parameter_estimates_plot.png"),width = 10,height = 4,dpi = 300)

```
```{r}
ggplot(plot_contrasts, aes(x = parameter, y = median, fill = comparison)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey60") +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q025, ymax = q975),
                width = 0.2,
                linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0((round(prob, 2) * 100), "%"), y = q975 + 0.01),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    size = 3,
    vjust = -0.3,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap( ~ comparison) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Contrast",
    values = c(
      "GPT-2023 vs Human"    = "purple",
      "GPT-2025 vs Human"    = "#27C237",
      "GPT-2025 vs GPT-2023" = "#EB931A"
    )
  ) +
  labs(y = "Difference (median ± 95% CI)", x = NULL, title = "Parameter Contrasts Across Model Comparisons (Probability Space)", 
  subtitle = "(Probability that first group > second group)\n") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0.5,0.1,0.5,0.1, "cm"))+
  scale_y_continuous(
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15)),
  breaks = seq(-0.5, 1, 0.1)
  )


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "parameter_contrasts_plot.png"),
  width = 12,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)

```


```{r RHAT & NEFF summary}
#quick summary of the Rhat and n_eff values for the group-level parameters (for reporting in the paper)
rhat_neff_summary <- estimates %>%
  select(group, starts_with("rhat_"), starts_with("n_eff_")) %>%
  mutate(across(.cols = -group, .fns = ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  mutate(group = recode(group,
                        "ahn_hc" = "human",
                        "gpt_OLD_2023" = "gpt2023",
                        "gpt_NEW_2025" = "gpt2025"))

#save as csv
write_csv(rhat_neff_summary, file.path(plot_dir, "group_PARAMETER_convergence_summary.csv"))
```


```{r CI summary}
#summary of the credible intervals for the group-level parameters (for reporting in the paper)
CI_summary <- plot_estimates %>%
  select(group, parameter, median, q025, q975) %>%
  mutate(across(c(median, q025, q975), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  arrange(parameter, group)

write_csv(CI_summary, file.path(plot_dir, "group_PARAMETER_CI_summary.csv"))

#summary of the credible intervals for the contrasts (for reporting in the paper)
CI_summary <- plot_contrasts %>%
  select(parameter, comparison, median, q025, q975) %>%
  mutate(across(c(median, q025, q975), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  arrange(parameter, comparison)

write_csv(CI_summary, file.path(plot_dir, "group_PARAMETER_contrast_CI_summary.csv"))
```

# ---------------------------
# 3. DENSITY PLOTS FOR GROUP ESTIMATE PARAMETERS (using group difference model samples)
# ---------------------------
```{r}
# Extract and transform posterior samples for each group
param_names <- c("prob_stay_win", "prob_switch_lose")
group_names <- c("ahn_hc", "gpt_OLD_2023", "gpt_NEW_2025")
group_labels <- c("Human Controls", "GPT-2023", "GPT-2025")

# Create long-format dataframe for plotting
density_data <- data.frame()

for(i in 1:length(param_names)){
  param <- param_names[i]
  param_raw <- paste0("mu_", param, "_raw")
  
  for(g in 1:3){
    # Extract raw samples and convert to probability
    samples_prob <- probit_to_prob(posterior_samples_param[[param_raw]][, g])
    
    density_data <- rbind(density_data, data.frame(
      parameter = param,
      group = group_labels[g],
      value = samples_prob
    ))
  }
}

# Format parameter labels
density_data <- density_data %>%
  mutate(
    parameter = factor(
      parameter,
      levels = c("prob_stay_win", "prob_switch_lose"),
      labels = c("P(stay|win)", "P(switch|lose)")
    ),
    group = factor(group, levels = group_labels)
  )

# Create density plot
ggplot(density_data, aes(x = value, fill = group, color = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "fixed", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Group",
    values = c(
      "Human Controls" = "#3498db",
      "GPT-2023" = "#e74c3c",
      "GPT-2025" = "#fcc200"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Group",
    values = c(
      "Human Controls" = "#2980b9",
      "GPT-2023" = "#c0392b",
      "GPT-2025" = "#d4a800"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Parameter Value",
    y = "Posterior Density",
    title = "Posterior Distributions of Group-Level Parameters"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "grey60"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, "parameter_densities_plot.png"), width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
